description: Food Diary entries (what, kind, place, local time, dishes, photo) for a civil date range in the account timezone (max 92 days; default today), oldest first. Optional place narrows to one venue. Each entry has food_id. ($0.05; API key required)

at.description: Optional ISO instant to read "today" at (defaults to now).

from.description: First civil day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the account timezone. Alone = that one day. Default: today.

place.description: Optional venue or merchant to match.

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone of the user's device (e.g. Asia/Singapore). Used only when the account has no zone set; the profile zone wins.

name: get_food_log
title: Get Food Log
